record.field: Is there a court case settlement after the reporting period that determines the entity had a present obligation at the end of the reporting period?

Is there information indicating impairment of asset values at the end of the reporting period or the need to adjust amounts previously recognized as impairment losses? Examples: (i) a customer bankruptcy occurring after the reporting period typically confirms a loss on trade receivables, and (ii) inventory sales after the reporting period may provide evidence of net realizable value.
Is there a determination after the reporting period of the acquisition cost of assets purchased or the proceeds from assets sold before the end of the reporting period?

Is there payment of profit-sharing or bonuses after the reporting period where the entity has a present legal or constructive obligation at the end of the reporting period to make the payment as a result of events after that date (SAK 57)?
Has there been discovery of fraud or error indicating that the financial statements are incorrect?
Has there been a significant business combination or disposal of a significant subsidiary after the reporting period?
Has there been an announcement to discontinue an operation?
Has there been, or is there a plan to, purchase significant assets?
Is there classification of assets as assets held for sale in accordance with PSAK 58?
Has there been, or is there a plan for, the disposal of other significant assets?
Has there been significant expropriation of assets by the Government?
Has there been significant damage to production facilities due to fire after the reporting period?
Has there been an announcement of or the commencement of a significant restructuring?
Are there significant transactions in ordinary shares and potential ordinary shares after the reporting period (PSAK 56)?
Has there been an issuance of debt instruments?
Have there been significant abnormal changes after the reporting period in asset prices or foreign exchange rates?
Have there been changes in tax rates or tax regulations enacted or announced after the reporting period that have a significant effect on current and deferred tax assets and liabilities?
Has there been the giving of commitments or the incurrence of significant contingent liabilities, for example the issuance of significant guarantees?
Has there been the commencement of significant legal proceedings arising solely from events occurring after the reporting period?
Have there been events that are relevant to the measurement of estimates or provisions recognized in the financial statements?
Have there been events that are relevant to the recoverability of assets?
